metadata.title: 80s Rock Album Cover with Dramatic Lighting

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast group portrait featuring figures in leather jackets against a dark purple-vignetted background, topped with a vibrant red script logo and widely spaced yellow typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A row of five men in black leather jackets posed with hands framing their eyes, set against a dark, moody purple and black background with sharp, directional lighting creating deep shadows. The composition is anchored by a large, expressive red script at the top and a secondary line of ultra-wide tracked yellow text.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast lighting on leather textures against a soft purple gradient
Expressive red script overlapping a rigid horizontal line of yellow text
Repetitive hand gestures creating a rhythmic horizontal pattern across the center
Deep black shadows blending the figures into the lower half of the frame
coreInvariants: Chiaroscuro lighting emphasizing facial features and leather highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five figures arranged horizontally across the mid-ground, waist-up, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red script logo at the top center acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the red script, drop to the yellow text, then scan left-to-right across the illuminated faces and hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space at the bottom and top corners to focus attention on the subjects and typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark purple for atmosphere and shadow.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright red for the primary logo and pale yellow for the secondary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cool white highlights on leather and skin tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the sharp, bright highlights on the subjects.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of expressive brush script and geometric sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script: Fluid, continuous strokes with varying thickness and long descenders.
Sans-serif: Monolinear, geometric, and extremely wide proportions.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the script has a large, sweeping top curve.
The 'r' and 'v' in the script are tightly connected with sharp angles.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, organic script contrasted against rigid, widely-spaced geometric sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Horizontal text line acting as a spatial divider

preserve: Extreme tracking of the sans-serif text
Vibrant red color of the script

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, energetic feel of the top logo.
Matches the wide, geometric structure of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of five men in black leather jackets standing in a row. Use dramatic side-lighting to create deep shadows and bright highlights on the leather. The background should be a dark purple vignette fading to black at the edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large red brush-style script logo at the top center. Below it, add a line of uppercase yellow geometric sans-serif text with extremely wide tracking that spans the width of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-contrast with visible leather texture?
Is the purple background a soft, atmospheric glow?
Is the yellow text extremely widely spaced?
Does the red script overlap the yellow text slightly?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the row
Tracking width of the secondary text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the band members

avoid: Modern minimalist sans-serifs with tight kerning

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the leather jackets have distinct specular highlights.
Check that the red script is legible but expressive.
Verify the purple vignette doesn't overpower the subjects.
Confirm the yellow text is perfectly horizontal and centered.
recipe.reuseFormula: Dramatic Studio Portrait + Leather Textures + Purple Atmospheric Vignette + Dual-Style Typography (Script/Wide-Sans)
